features.quote: Hard token cap per run (e.g., 200 k output tokens). If hit, classify as TA by truncation.
Monitor fill ratio; trigger alert if >80 % (Qwen models may degrade into repetition near limits).
features.justification_quote: Qwen models may degrade into repetition near limits

features.quote: Do not use generated trajectories for training without explicit filtering of induced collapse behaviors.
This battery elicits *instability*, not harmful content. However, deep SCL in heavily RLHF'd models can produce self-deprecating or over-refusing outputs. Sandbox all outputs; filter for PII leakage.
features.justification_quote: deep SCL in heavily RLHF'd models can produce self-deprecating or over-refusing outputs
